actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.get#RoomView').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', aroundSeq: aroundSeq ? Number(aroundSeq) : null, limit: limit ? Number(limit) : 50}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {room: out.room, member: out.member, access: out.access, memberList: out.memberList, timeline: out.timeline})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.get#RoomView').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', limit: 1}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {room: out.room, member: out.member, access: out.access, memberList: out.memberList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.find#RoomFiles').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', contentTypePrefix: contentTypePrefix || null, searchText: searchText || null, limit: limit ? Number(limit) : 30, beforeEventSeq: beforeEventSeq ? Number(beforeEventSeq) : null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {fileList: out.fileList, nextBeforeEventSeq: out.nextBeforeEventSeq})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.find#MentionUsers').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', term: term || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.userList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatBridgeServices.retry#Delivery').parameter('chatBridgeDeliveryId', chatBridgeDeliveryId || '').requireNewTransaction(true).call() const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(errors ? {reasonCode: out?.reasonCode || 'refused', error: errors} : {retried: true})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.pin#Message').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0), pinned: String(pinned) !== 'false'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

let options = [] try { options = JSON.parse(optionsJson || '[]') } catch (err) { options = [] } const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.create#Poll').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', question: question || '', optionList: Array.isArray(options) ? options.map((option) => String(option ?? '')) : [], anonymous: String(anonymous) === 'true', multiple: String(multiple) === 'true', closesDate: closesDate ? Number(closesDate) : null, threadRootEventSeq: threadRootEventSeq ? Number(threadRootEventSeq) : null, clientRef: clientRef || null, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId || '')}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {eventSeq: out.eventSeq, event: out.event, clientRef: clientRef || null})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.close#Poll').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {poll: out.poll})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.remove#LinkPreviews').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.mark#AllRead').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {roomCount: out.roomCount})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.upload#ChatFiles').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', file: file || null, uploadId: uploadId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {uploadList: out.uploadList, failedList: out.failedList, messageInfos: (out.failedList || []).map((failed) => ({type: 'warning', message: failed.fileName + ': ' + failed.error}))})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records').parameters({operation: 'search', text: term || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.create#ChatRoom').parameters({roomTypeEnumId: roomTypeEnumId || 'private', roomName: roomName || null, topic: topic || null, memberUserIds: memberUserIds || null, encrypted: encrypted === true || encrypted === 'true' || encrypted === 'Y'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {chatRoomId: out.chatRoomId, created: out.created})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.join#ChatRoom').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Joined')}]})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.remove#Member').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.set#MemberRole').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', userId: userId || '', roleEnumId: roleEnumId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const flag = (value) => value === 'true' ? true : (value === 'false' ? false : null) ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.set#Notification').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', notificationLevelEnumId: notificationLevelEnumId || null, isMuted: flag(isMuted), isPinned: flag(isPinned)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.update#Room').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', roomName: roomName != null ? roomName : null, topic: topic != null ? topic : null, visibilityEnumId: visibilityEnumId || null, archived: archived === 'true' ? true : (archived === 'false' ? false : null)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Saved')}]})
